messages:
alex: noticing a weird thing on the latency dashboard for /api/v1/generate — p50 is higher than p95 for the route split 😕
mira: wait what — can you paste the chart or the query?
alex: screenshot attached in the thread (chart shows p50 220ms, p95 180ms) — query is `latency_ms.pctl(50) by endpoint` and same for p95
sam: that smells like aggregation/sample-weighting mismatch. did the canary rollout split traffic across variants?
alex: yes, we rolled out variant-b to 10% about ~2h ago. the dashboard rollup is 'merged' across variants at the endpoint level
raj: if the rollup is merging pre-aggregated tdigest sketches without proper sample counts, quantiles can invert. we had a similar footgun with rollup=merge last year
mira: hmm — console currently shows percentiles but not the sample_count for the aggregated row. that makes it hard to judge correctness from the UI
ui-bot: suggestion: add a small sample_count column next to p50/p95 and a tooltip linking to docs about merge vs composite aggregation :bulb:
sam: can we reproduce with a local query? try `select pctl(50) as p50, pctl(95) as p95, sum(count) as cnt from rollup where endpoint='/api/v1/generate' group by variant`
alex: quick run locally shows per-variant p50s: variant-a 180ms cnt=900, variant-b 500ms cnt=100. global merged p50 ended up ~220 because merge path didn't reweight counts correctly — but p95 calculation was run against raw samples for some reason (inconsistent pipeline)
raj: that inconsistency is the bug. pipeline A uses tdigest-merge, pipeline B falls back to raw-scan for tails. when the two feeds are combined, the UI uses p95 from feed B and p50 from feed A -> inversion
mira: ops question: could quota routing/fallback have sent a bunch of requests to a cheaper region which uses a different telemetry emitter? that would explain mixed calculus
sam: yes — quota overflow to region-west sends traffic to fallback endpoint with different emitter version. we pushed a telemetry change there last month (v2 tdigest -> v3 samplecount field name changed)
alex: ohhh. so two dimensions: rollout split + region fallback -> mixed aggregation formats. scoreboard: wrong merge assumptions in rolluper, UI displays pctl without showing sample provenance
ui-bot: low-effort UX fix: show an orange indicator when percentiles are sourced from mixed aggregation formats and add hover copy: "mixed sources: p50 from aggregated tdigest, p95 from raw samples"
raj: longer term: update rolluper to normalize tdigest metadata (include sample_count and min/max) and prefer a single canonical pctl source per timebucket. also need a migration shim for v2->v3 emitter fields
mira: i'll open a console UX ticket for the sample_count column + mixed-source badge. alex can you file an eng-platform issue with repro steps and the local query you ran?
alex: filing now. will include the `select pctl(50), pctl(95), sum(count)` snippet, the timeframe, and the canary + quota routing logs. tagging @sam @raj for triage :spiral_note_pad:
sam: i'll take the rolluper bug. quick patch: detect heterogeneous emitter schema and force composite recalculation for affected buckets, plus an alert on pctl inversion (p50>p95) as a safety net
raj: also add a nightly job that scans endpoints for inversion statistical anomalies and emits a report to #incidents-ops
alex: thanks y'all. interim: we should add a small console note under percentiles: "percentiles may be inconsistent during rollouts or cross-region fallbacks — hover for details"
mira: agreed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued for rolluper fix branch `rolluper/normalize-tdigest` — CI 4/5 passed, canary scheduled in 30m
alex: great — will follow up after canary results and update the dashboard ticket with before/after screenshots
mira: awesome, keep us posted :eyes:
